Who was the Chairman of the Partition Committee constituted by Madras State Government for the formation of separate State?
x:
Following the decision to create a separate Andhra State, the Madras Government constituted a Partition Committee to divide the assets, liabilities, government institutions, employees and administrative responsibilities between the proposed Andhra State and the residual Madras State. The committee was chaired by T. T. Krishnamachari, an eminent statesman and later Union Finance Minister. The committee played a crucial role in ensuring the orderly division of administrative and financial resources before the formation of Andhra State on 1 October 1953.
Hence, the correct answer is
Option (1).
n: Partition Committee Chairman – T. T. Krishnamachari
